provider: Beget S3 (Russia) — free egress S3 at 350 Mbit/s

free_tier.stated: No free allowance: pay-as-you-go at 0.07 RUB per 1 GB per day on used space; unlimited buckets, unlimited traffic on a 350 Mbit/s port, free GET/POST/PUT requests; stored volume is not capped.

per_object_cap.stated: 50 TB maximum object size; 5 GB maximum per upload request; at most 10000 segments in a segmented upload.
per_object_cap.notes: stated in the vendor's technical-limits list (control-panel guide)

egress.terms: FREE and generous: «Безлимитный трафик. Полоса 350 Мбит/с. Бесплатные GET/POST/PUT-запросы» — unlimited traffic, 350 Mbit/s, free GET/POST/PUT requests. A Russian price-comparison article (serverdelo.ru, prices verified 2026-10-03) independently confirms «Скачивать бесплатно можно у Beget и Рег.облака. Трафик и запросы входят в цену».

tooling: S3 API, HTTPS, FTP; Terraform provider (github.com/LTD-Beget/terraform-provider-beget); rclone `s3`; custom subdomain + auto SSL. Documentation and CORS supported.
chaining: Per-GB daily, no cap — same rate at 5 TB and 20 TB.

limits.value: 50 TB per object; 5 GB per upload request

limits_note: 350 Mbit/s is the port cap, about 3.8 TB per day (derived), so serving 1 TiB per day fits with no burst; stored volume is not capped and billing is per GB per day.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: behind a sign-up; the product page does not state what registration requires (payment card, phone).

reliability_note: Long-running Russian shared host with 24/7 support and 99.98 % stated availability. No throttling evidence found. The commercial risk is FX: rouble pricing on a foreign card will carry the same discrimination pattern seen at Yandex.
confidence_note: Re-read on 2026-11-03 from vendor pages: https://beget.com/ru/cloud/storage (0.07 RUB per 1 GB per day; 350 Mbit/s port; unlimited buckets; availability 99,98%), https://beget.com/ru/kb/manual/obektnoe-hranilishche-s3-v-beget (50 TB object, 5 GB per upload request, 2000 requests per second, unlimited volume) and https://beget.com/ru/publichnaya-oferta (acceptance is by registering on the site; registration fields not listed).
